end.summary:
Practised ordering: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Yash gave 3 unaided correct sequences across 6 attempts.
Discussed heart as an organ and the circulatory system as an organ system containing organs such as the heart and blood vessels.
Teach-back was not passed; the organ/organ-system mix-up remained at the end.
Also discussed amoeba as a single-celled organism and identified stomach and digestive system in an example sequence.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation using examples such as muscle cell → muscle tissue → heart → circulatory system → human. Yash correctly explained that cells form tissues and tissues form organs, and they connected amoeba with a single-celled organism. The distinction between an organ and an organ system still needs another clear review. At home, ask them to place five cards—cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism—in order and give one example for each.
